hero.label: Made for Hypercubic
hero.headline: I'm thrilled to join Hypercubic's groundbreaking journey into enterprise sales.
hero.subheadline: I'm excited about Hypercubic's innovative approach and the chance to shape its enterprise sales strategy from the ground up. Collaborating with a dynamic team in such a pivotal role aligns well with my background and aspirations.

whyCompany.title: Innovative approach driving change
whyCompany.body: Hypercubic's unique solutions in the tech industry set it apart as a leader. I'm eager to contribute to a company that values innovation and forward-thinking strategies.

whyCompany.title: Thriving startup atmosphere
whyCompany.body: Joining Hypercubic at this early stage offers the rare chance to directly influence its growth. The founding enterprise sales role provides an exciting opportunity to drive significant business impact.

whyCompany.title: BDR and digital marketing synergy
whyCompany.body: My BDR experience at Copygen.ai and digital marketing expertise from NextAfter equip me to excel in this role. I'm prepared to apply my skills in cold outreach and client acquisition to Hypercubic's ambitious goals.

quote: I'm eager to shape Hypercubic's enterprise sales strategy and make a tangible impact.
